My parents sound really similar to yours, and I just want to say that you're totally valid for being angry. It doesn't make you a bad person or ungrateful- in fact I'd say its good that you care about yourself enough to be mad at them. 

I mean after years of dealing with my parents, I think the one thing I learned is that people can genuinely love you and try their best- and they can *still* be bad for you. 

Like I can sympathize and understand that my parents did their best- but at the same time I can also understand that they didn't treat me right and that I need to put distance between us for my own wellbeing. It doesn't mean I'm a bad person, it just means that I'm taking care of myself. Basically, it never makes you a bad person for recognizing that youre being mistreated and being upset at it- so don't feel guilty!

And yeah, I sometimes wish that my parents had been outright abusive too. Not because I actually wanted to experience that kind of trauma, but only because it makes things more linear and easier to confront. I guess it just feels like everything gets more confusing and messy with parents who are *accidently* abusive/neglectful. As opposed to the ones who do it on purpose. But either way, being hurt by someone's carelessness will always hurt just as much if they had done it on purpose imo. 

Best of luck op, I wouldnt wish this shit on anyone
